integrity: The source equations, endemic-equilibrium formulas, next-generation threshold, and bifurcation claims were inspected from the publisher full text. The correction is derived symbolically from the printed ODEs. A bundled standard-library checker independently reconstructs the baseline equilibrium and residual identity.
scientific_limitations: The theorem proves only local uniqueness and forward direction of the endemic branch near the disease-free threshold.
The endemic Jacobian and the reported Hopf points are not recomputed.
Generic awareness-driven epidemic bifurcations are established in prior literature; the new content is the exact source-specific algebraic correction and scalar reduction.
title: Corrected endemic-equilibrium algebra and a rigorous forward branch in an awareness-driven SEIQHRA model
